_help: Each product: 'terms' match KEV entries, Oracle advisory rows and news (case-insensitive; prefix 're:' for a regex). 'nvd_keywords' are NVD CVE searches. 'news_query' is a Google News search. 'feeds' are news/research RSS feeds, kept only when an item matches a product's terms. 'oracle_feed' is Oracle's security-alert RSS; each advisory page is parsed for per-product CVEs.
